pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:78 The colour-literal gate blocks for real but its pattern-based normalisation erases genuine violations (a probe of `.a-mask:hover { color: #123456; }` counted 0), and the walk has no population floor, misses other colour forms and reads stylesheets only, so its green overstates what the tokens.css rule claims.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:78 The mask pass runs up to the next ; or } from any text ending in 'mask...:', so a selector like .a-mask:hover swallows its first declaration, with no seeded pair to catch it. Line 56's token-read scan also reads raw text, comments included, with no stated reason; no token currently depends on that (0 of 150 measured).

apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:75 No floor on the walked population and no known-bad fixture: the one file guaranteed present is exempted two lines later, so an empty walk reports clean. The same file asserts a floor for font URLs at line 175.

apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:68 Measured 0 hits for tomato, rebeccapurple, hwb(...) and color(display-p3 ...). The escape set is CSS's own fixed grammar and the tree is owned, yet unrecognised forms pass silently.

apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:71 A location key: moving a colour from a stylesheet to an inline style clears the check with the colour still rendered. Director.tsx:636 already writes rgb(...) inline.

apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.css:14 The rule covers the client; the mechanism covers .css only. No other test walks TS/TSX for colours, so writing one there fails nothing, and Director.tsx:636 is a live case.

apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:77 A standing exemption scoped to a directory when it covers exactly one file (devInspector.css), with no reaper. The per-name SCALE_OR_PINNED list at line 45 is the conforming form.
apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:82 A finding fails the assertion, the vite include matches this file, and the CI client job runs pnpm test.
apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:12 The verdict is a function of the tree being gated, with no external feed, so it has earned blocking.

apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:65 The detector was narrowed rather than the gate dropped: five real mask declarations carry #000 for alpha only. The over-reach of that narrowing is recorded under match-the-resolved-artifact.
apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:79 A literal in a stylesheet is decidable from that one file; no call graph is needed.
apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:18 A token the contrast floor cannot read refuses instead of comparing a missing value and passing.
apps/desktop/client/src/design/tokens.test.ts:80 The message gives file and count and names no remedy, so there is no remedy to resolve; this technique assumes one is named.

pairs.registryProposal: refusal-names-a-reachable-remedy opens by deferring 'the message contains a remedy' to a technique under metric-gates, so a plain predicate gate whose refusal names no remedy at all has no owning rule inside quality-gates.
